walkthrough:
The centre lies on the perpendicular bisector because both radii are equal.
Calculate midpoint and gradient of chord $AB$:
$$M = \left(\dfrac{-1 + 7}{2}, \dfrac{5 + 1}{2}\right) = (3, 3)$$
$$m_{AB} = \dfrac{1 - 5}{7 - (-1)} = -\dfrac{4}{8} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$$

Find perpendicular gradient and form bisector equation:
$$m_\perp = -\dfrac{1}{-1/2} = 2$$
$$y - 3 = 2(x - 3) \implies y - 3 = 2x - 6 \implies 2x - y = 3$$

hints: Solve $2x - y = 3$ and $x + y = 12$ simultaneously: $3x = 15 \implies x = 5, y = 7$, so centre is $(5, 7)$.
